title: Show that the selected HPE binding accepts a self-partner tail gate
body:
## Summary
- The hyperplane-end label statement requires the cleanup gate `h -= p` to use two different registers. The instance checker rejects `h == p`. The selected binding script does not read the partner index.
- A synthetic 38-gate tail, using all three Lean pairs and coefficient `-1`, has one gate whose helper is its own partner. The binding rules accept it. A coefficient of `+1` is rejected.
- The word is not an emitted supplier word. No Lean build and no new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/hpe-partner-binding/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/hpe-partner-binding/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-partner-binding`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
